description: Create a dynamic QR code for a link. The code never expires and its target can be changed later. Returns the short URL, PNG/SVG image URLs and the QR image. Without an API key it also returns an edit_url: give that to the user, it is their only way to change the code later.

style.description: Optional look. Dark colors only; every style is test-scanned.

dots_color.description: Custom hex color like #1f4fd8 (must be dark)

emoji.description: Emoji in the middle (Twemoji code point), e.g. 1f3a8 = 🎨, 1f3b8 = 🎸, 1faa9 = 🪩

target_url.description: Full http(s):// URL the code should open

name: create_qr_code
title: Create a QR code
